Name: Aimon's Big Swamp Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][i][color=#fff2cc][u]﻿Enjoyed playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631]Small Swamp Farm[/url][/u][/color][/i][i][color=#fff2cc][u] but wish for something bigger? Here it is![/u][/color][/i]

[/size][/center][center][b][size=3][color=#ffe599]﻿This mod adds big sized custom farm, with lots of water and swampy themed decor.[/color]

[u]Big thanks to [/u][/size][size=3][u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/TJGamerWolf]TJGamerWolf[/url]﻿ for commissioning me on this map![/u][/size]

[/b][/center][center][/center][size=3][b][color=#ffe599]Recommended mods:[/color][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt&Grass Recolor [/url]- to make it all look... well, swampy.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/mods?gameId=1303]BogWyytch's mods[/url]  - if you're looking for witchy buildings and retextures.[/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27656]Luny's Purple Swamp Fields[/url] - adds matching witchy grass for the farm.[/size]
[/list]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=4]Features:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]A few recolors - green and purple (and optional recolors Bog's Gray for Fall)[/size]
[*][u][size=3][color=#fff2cc][b]NOTE[/b]:[/color] recolors only affect custom farm decor (lilypads, reeds and ivy trees). For matching dirt and grass use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28948]Witchy Dirt&Grass Recolor.[/url]﻿[/size][/u]
[*][size=3]Custom starter giftbox items - (choose before starting new save file!)[/size]
[*][size=3]Special visual effects (mist during rain/night and shadows around map borders)[/size]
[*][size=3]Respawable forage and hardwood stumps.[/size]
[*][size=3]Small custom quarry space.[/size]
[*][size=3]Secret Woods passage - adds warps to SecretWoods map (blocked by hardwood log for better immersion).[/size]
[*][size=3]Grandpha's Shed passage - adds warp to Grandpha's Shed map if SVE is installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]Hidden space for silos.[/size]
[*][size=3]Catch different types of fish depends on water type (mountain fish in upper lakes, forest/river fish in bottom rivers)[/size]
[*][size=3]Extra swamp themed fish if Distant Lands is installed (Void Minnow, Purple Algae and also swamp themed crabpot fish)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u][b]Don't want respawnable forage in farm?[/b][/u]
Go to your "Mods" folder, open "Aimon's Big Swamp Farm", > "[FTM] Big Swamp Farm" and open content.json file with any text editor.
Find "ForageSpawnEnabled" and change it to "false"
Save the changes.
Done!

[b][u]Don't want small pond near farmhouse or crop fields? [/u][/b]
You can config it in mod's config! (Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM mod[/url] for more convenient ingame config)


[img]https://imgur.com/QoiZHAg.png[/img]
[u][b]New Save File Options:[/b]
[color=#ea9999]Choose those [b]BEFORE[/b] you start new save file (won't take effect on already existing save files)[/color]
[/u][list]
[*][size=3][b]Starter Gift[/b] - Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (will only work if you start fresh game - choose BEFORE creating new save file. Default set to [b]Swamping[/b])[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][b]Blue Grass Patches[/b] - true/false (default set to [b]false[/b])[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Add Coop[/b] - Adds empty coop building in Farm. (default set to [b]false[/b]). Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]
[b][u][color=#ffe599]Recolor Options:[/color][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=3][b]Recolor[/b] - Green, Purple[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Bog's Fall Recolor[/b] - true/false[/size]
[/list][b][u][color=#ffe599]Map Additions:[/color][/u][/b][list]
[*][size=3][b]Trees&Crop Areas[/b] - true, false[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Visible Silos Space[/b] - true, false[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Gravel Shore[/b] - true, false[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Spawn Supply Crates on Gravel Shore[/b] - true, false[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Small Pond[/b] - true, false[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Distant Lands Fish [/b]- true, false[/size]
[/list][/size][u][b][color=#ffe599][size=3]Starter Giftbox items available:[/size][/color][/b][/u]
[size=3]﻿﻿- Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler
﻿﻿﻿﻿- Swamping- will give you 10 Clay, and 15 Parsnip Seeds
- Swamping (Alt) -  will give you 30 Rice Sprout Seeds, 1 Recycling Machine and 1 Witch Hat
﻿- Foraging - will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat
﻿- Fishing - will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod
﻿- Combating - will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs
﻿ ﻿-Mining - will give you 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item
﻿- Ranching - will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies
﻿﻿- Floristing - will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat
﻿﻿- Jojaing - ??? [/size]

[size=3][img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible[/color][/b] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...[/size]
[*][size=3][color=#b6d7a8][b]Compatible[/b][/color] with any recolors and retextures. [/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b][u][color=#ffe599]Note:[/color][/u][/b] if you use Better Water 2 mod, different water configs may affect how water looks in farm (I used Semi-Opaque option on my screenshots).

[b][u][color=#ffe599]NOTE for SVE compatibility [/color][/u][/b]- the custom Enchanted Grove warp location is [b][u][color=#ffe599]x = 172, y = 10[/color] [/u][/b]- change it in SVE config.

[img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, Farm Type Manager[/size]
[*][size=3]Install DaisyNiko's Tilesheets and Alvadea's Tilesheets﻿﻿[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu﻿[/size]
[*][size=3](Optional) - Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ if you want prespawned Coop building in Farm.[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip "Aimon's Big Swamp Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy![/size]
[/list][size=3]
[/size][center][size=3]
[b][color=#ffe599]Mods used on screenshots:[/color][/b]
----------------------------
BogWyytch's mods﻿
Witchy Dirt&Grass Recolor
Luny's Purple Swamp Fields
Vibrant Pastoral Recolor
VPR Temporary fix 1.6
Medieval DNT ( DaisyNiko's Tilesheets retexture )

Simple Foliage
Better Water 2
Visible Fish
Stardew Valley Expanded
----------------------------[/size][/center]
